$schema-note: aidlc-demo roster + loop config. Paths are relative to the aidlc-demo skill directory. The orchestrator role-plays ONE audience persona at a time in chat and waits for the developer (the user) to answer. Reorder 'audience[]' to change who asks first; disable a persona with "enabled": false; add one by appending an object with its own persona file.

session_notes.note: APPEND a brief gap block to sessions/demo-gaps.md at every demo close-out. Never a new file per session. Not under bug-analysis/. Rate-limiting / Task-spend / timeout / concurrency first.

presentation.pitch_prompt: Give a 3-5 sentence demo pitch of what you built: the problem, what it does, and how it works.
